KEY FEATURES INCLUDED

What This Website Offers

Practical modules and structured pages designed specifically for restaurant websites.

Digital Food & Drink Menu

Categorized starters, mains, grills, platters and drinks with transparent pricing and appetizing descriptions.

Appetizing Dish Showcase

High-clarity food photography sections designed to highlight signature meals and chef specials.

Instant WhatsApp Ordering

One-tap ordering buttons that send meal requests directly to your kitchen or delivery desk on WhatsApp.

Table & Event Reservations

Simple reservation enquiry sections for dine-in groups, celebrations and catering requests.

Opening Hours & Availability

Upfront daily opening times and delivery coverage details so diners always know when you are open.

Location & Directions

Clear street address, landmarks and map links making it easy for diners to walk right in.

Core Sections & Capabilities Covered

  • Digital food menu
  • Food photographs
  • Prices
  • WhatsApp ordering
  • Restaurant location
  • Opening hours
  • Reservation enquiries

Who Needs This Website

Tailored for individuals, teams and organisations looking for a dependable, modern digital presence in this space:

RestaurantsCafesFast-food businessesCatering companies

Mobile Responsiveness

Hungry diners search menus and place orders on their phones while on the move. Your digital menu, dish prices and WhatsApp Order button load rapidly with zero pinching or zooming required.

Benefits for Your Brand or Organisation

  • Present appetizing food photography alongside clear, up-to-date menu pricing.
  • Enable direct WhatsApp meal orders without losing commission to third-party apps.
  • Help customers quickly find your address, opening hours and table booking options.
  • Attract event catering and group dining enquiries with a polished brand presence.

Available Integrations

  • Direct WhatsApp meal ordering & catering requests
  • Google Maps directions to your dining location
  • Table reservation enquiry form
  • QR code menu link compatibility for in-house tables

Security & Usability

  • Readable menu typography with clear price alignment
  • Fast-loading compressed food photography
  • Simple one-tap ordering and phone links
  • Consistent HTTPS security and reliable mobile layout
